title: Jagged Crispy Ethiopian Egg Noodles
description: A paleo-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring crispy egg noodles and a bitter poach, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional Ethiopian cuisine. It is light and refreshing, perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned and crispy.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the noodles and toss again to combine.
Increase the heat to high and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are crispy and lightly browned.
